decision: Keep best021; no arm passed the fixed complementarity gate. No resplit expansion.
summary: Adding spatial std improved the ConvNeXt PCA128 pipeline, but not the ResNet pipeline; neither improves best021 with the predeclared fixed10 percent blend.
mean_descriptor_preservation: All400 mean descriptors match existing native256 caches exactly. ConvNeXt keeps its existing post-pool LayerNorm on mean; appended population std comes from the same pre-pool spatial map, with no LayerNorm relocation.
capacity_control: Both arms use train-only full-SVD PCA128 and identical8321-parameter MLP, initial tensors, sample/dropout seeds, 100epochs/500updates. Their unsupervised PCA subspaces differ.
limits: Existing scratch TinyCNN already uses mean/std; novelty is this frozen pretrained descriptor and matched PCA/head control.

Mean descriptor preserved exactly from188/190; each arm has a different train-only PCA subspace. The experiment estimates the full pooling-plus-compression pipeline, not an isolated std effect under fixed PCA axes.
PCA128 can discard signal. Failed comparison does not prove all spatial variability is useless or backbone capacity is exhausted.
Spatial std is a marginal dispersion statistic, not spatial arrangement or physical grain segmentation.
Reused development400 and conditional bootstrap are not independent validation or selection-adjusted evidence.
